title: Untouched subsets and a counterexample to the Nestoridi–Yan biased-transposition limit-profile conjecture
description: Unrefereed candidate proof of an unconditional counterexample to Conjecture 1.6 in arXiv:2409.16387v1, supported by an observable slow-subset event, a finite-moment alternative and exact arithmetic certificates. It does not solve the general t_mix = t_star + O(n) upper-bound problem, supply a replacement profile, establish priority, or constitute formal or external verification.
